name: read_fpl_schur
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd()
for n in ['fpl','schur']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',f'sources/{n}.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print(n,'CHARS',len(r.stdout));print(r.stdout[:18000] if n=='fpl' else r.stdout[:16000])
